title: 第14章 先天强者的洞府

content_zh:
“你们是谁？”萧叶问道，这两人身上隐隐散发出的血腥味，不像是青阳镇的村民。
“杀你的人！”肥胖的男子一副胜券在握的样子，朝着萧叶走去。
肥胖男子的真气爆发，他伸手轻描淡写的朝着萧叶拍去，以他后天三重初期的修为，即使没有动用全力，这一掌也不容小觑，开碑裂石不在话下。
“杀我？”感受到对方身上的真气波动，萧叶不屑一笑。
就凭后天三重初期的修为，还想杀他？
“猛虎拳势！”
萧叶心头大喝，经脉中的真气如同江河般汹涌起来，他迎着肥胖男子直接一拳轰出，拳锋之上劲道整合，化作一个凶猛的虎头扑出，虎啸之声震得四周的林木左右摇晃。
以他如今的修为，施展猛虎拳势威力远胜以往。
只听见惨叫声夹杂着手骨断裂声响彻而起，一个肥胖的身影鲜血狂喷，如同皮球一般被轰飞十步开外，气息全无。
“什么！”
站在一旁的瘦弱男子瞳孔剧烈收缩，满脸的不可置信。
“你的修为，居然达到了后天三重初期？”紧接着，瘦弱男子便被震撼了。他们从萧霸那里得到的信息，萧叶明明才后天一重的修为啊。
“是我们大意了。”瘦弱男子放下双手，面色阴沉下来。肥胖男子被一招轰杀，他将其归结于是大意所致。
“大意？”萧叶像是看白痴一般看着他，“你们到底是谁？”
瘦弱男子活动着筋骨，后天境三重巅峰的气息冲天而起，举手投足都有着强大的气势缭绕。
“反正你马上都要死了，那我不妨告诉你，我们是血狼帮的！”瘦弱男子狞笑一声，身形暴起，冲向萧叶。
“血狼帮！”听到这三个字，萧叶眼神冰冷，内心杀意汹涌。
他无法忘记，血狼帮大当家将萧阳打成废人，差点将他的家毁了。没想到他还没去找血狼帮，对方就找上门来了。
那现在，就当收点利息吧。
“血狼帮的人，都该死！”萧叶眼神冰冷，浑厚的真气陡然运转起来，他朝前一步跨出，双掌齐齐拍出。

嘭嘭嘭嘭！
萧叶体内的真气进行四次叠加，四道轰鸣从体内传出，磅礴的力量嘶吼冲出去。这一刻，那瘦弱男子神情大变，满脸的骇然。
瘦弱男子如同惊涛骇浪中的一叶小舟，他甚至还没靠近萧叶，便被磅礴的力量轰飞。
“怎么可能！”瘦弱男子喷出一口鲜血，艰难的爬了起来。对方明明才后天境三重初期啊，为何拥有这么强大的力量，连他都被一掌拍飞？
“萧霸，你居然敢坑我，等老子出去，一定找人劈了你！”瘦弱男子只要一想到萧霸，便暴跳如雷，欲哭无泪。
早知道萧叶的实力这么强，借他十个胆子他也不敢来啊。
望着面前仿若无敌战神的少年，瘦弱男子畏惧的后退着。
“小子，你别太狂妄，我可是血狼帮的人，如果你敢动我，我灭你全家！”瘦弱男子大声道。
他可不信，这样一个山野少年，敢和强大的血狼帮叫板。
但回应他的，却是一只脚掌。
萧叶表情冷漠，一脚将瘦弱男子踩翻，让其惨叫连连，再次喷出一口鲜血。
“灭我全家？你认为你有那个机会？”萧叶杀气腾腾道。
家人是他不可触摸的逆鳞，更何况对方还是血狼帮的人。
萧叶脚掌用力，直接将瘦弱男子踩进泥土中，脸颊都被踩变形了，一口的牙齿被踩得脱落。
“别……别杀我。”瘦弱男子话语含糊不清的说道。
感受到这个少年身上传出的杀意，他害怕得瑟瑟发抖。
“你刚才不是挺硬气的，还想要灭我全家吗？”萧叶冷笑，脚下再次用力，一脚踩断了瘦弱男子数根肋骨。
瘦弱男子惨叫，面容因为巨大的痛苦而扭曲着。
“别杀我，我告诉你，是谁让我杀你的。”瘦弱男子连忙喊道。
“嗯？”萧叶目光微闪，将对方从地上提了起来，“说！”

迎着萧叶的森然目光，瘦弱男子打了个寒颤，说道：“是……你们村子的萧霸。他和我们二当家达成了协议，让我们二当家派人杀你。”
听到这两个字，萧叶双目涌现滔天怒意。他原本以为，自己展现天赋后，萧霸会老实下来，却没想到对方居然还不死心，勾结血狼帮想要杀了自己。

content_en:
"Who are you?" Xiao Ye asked. The faint smell of blood emanating from these two people did not look like the villagers of Qingyang Town.
"Kill your man!" The fat man walked towards Xiao Ye as if he was sure of victory.
The fat man's true energy exploded, and he reached out and lightly slapped Xiao Ye. With his early stage of acquired third-level cultivation, even if he didn't use all his strength, this palm could not be underestimated. It could break open monuments and crack rocks.
"Kill me?" Xiao Ye smiled disdainfully when he felt the zhenqi fluctuations on the other party's body.
With his early stage cultivation of the third level acquired, do you still want to kill him?
"Tiger Fist!"
Xiao Ye shouted in his heart, and the energy in his meridians surged like a river. He punched the obese man directly, and the strength of the fist was integrated, turning into a fierce tiger head and throwing out. The roar of the tiger shook the surrounding trees left and right.
With his current level of cultivation, the power of the Tiger Fist is far greater than before.
Only screams were heard mixed with the sound of broken hand bones. A fat figure spurted blood and was blasted ten steps away like a ball, without any breath.
"What!"
The thin man standing aside had his pupils contracted violently, his face full of disbelief.
"Your cultivation has actually reached the early stage of the third acquired level?" Immediately afterwards, the thin man was shocked. According to the information they got from Xiao Ba, Xiao Ye was only at the first level of acquired cultivation.
"We were careless." The thin man put down his hands and his expression became gloomy. The obese man was killed with one move, which he attributed to carelessness.
"Careless?" Xiao Ye looked at him as if he were an idiot, "Who are you?"
The thin man moved his muscles and bones, and the aura of the third level of Acquired Heaven Realm rose to the sky, and his every move was filled with powerful aura.
"You're going to die soon anyway, so I might as well tell you that we are from the Blood Wolf Gang!" The thin man laughed ferociously, rose up, and rushed towards Xiao Ye.
"Blood Wolf Gang!" Upon hearing these three words, Xiao Ye's eyes were cold and murderous intent surged in his heart.
He couldn't forget that the head of the Blood Wolf Gang beat Henry Zhang into a cripple and almost destroyed his home. Unexpectedly, before he went to find the Blood Wolf Gang, the other party came to his door.
Now, just charge some interest.
"Everyone from the Blood Wolf Gang deserves death!" Xiao Ye's eyes were cold, and his strong energy suddenly began to circulate. He took a step forward and clapped both palms together.
Bang bang bang bang!
The true energy in Xiao Ye's body was superimposed four times, four roars came out of the body, and the majestic power roared out. At this moment, the thin man's expression changed drastically, and his face was full of shock.
The thin man was like a small boat in the stormy waves. Before he even got close to Xiao Ye, he was blown away by the majestic force.
"How is that possible!" The thin man spat out a mouthful of blood and climbed up with difficulty. The opponent is clearly at the early stage of the third level of the Houtian Realm. Why does he have such a powerful power that even he was knocked away with a palm?
"Xiao Ba, you dare to trick me. When I get out, I will find someone to kill you!" The thin man would become furious whenever he thought of Xiao Ba, and he was about to cry without tears.
If he had known that Xiao Ye was so strong, he wouldn't have dared to come even if he had ten more courages.
Looking at the young man in front of him who looked like an invincible god of war, the thin man backed away in fear.
"Boy, don't be too arrogant. I am a member of the Blood Wolf Gang. If you dare to touch me, I will destroy your whole family!" the thin man said loudly.
He didn't believe that such a young man from the mountains dared to challenge the powerful Blood Wolf Gang.
But what responded to him was the sole of his foot.
Xiao Ye looked indifferent and stepped on the thin man, causing him to scream and spit out a mouthful of blood again.
"Destroy my whole family? Do you think you have that chance?" Xiao Ye said murderously.
His family is his untouchable enemy, not to mention that the other party is a member of the Blood Wolf Gang.
Xiao Ye used the force of his feet to directly trample the thin man into the dirt. His cheeks were deformed due to the trampling, and all his teeth were knocked off..
"Don't... don't kill me." The thin man said vaguely.
Feeling the killing intent coming from this young man, he shivered with fear.
"You were so stubborn just now, didn't you still want to destroy my whole family?" Xiao Ye sneered and used another force with his foot, crushing several of the thin man's ribs.
The thin man screamed, his face twisted in pain.
"Don't kill me, I'll tell you who asked me to kill you." The thin man shouted quickly.
"Huh?" Xiao Ye's eyes flickered, and he lifted the other person up from the ground, "Say!"
Facing Xiao Ye's solemn gaze, the thin man shuddered and said, "It's... Xiao Ba from your village. He has reached an agreement with our second master, and asked our second master to send someone to kill you."
Hearing these two words, Xiao Ye's eyes filled with overwhelming anger. He originally thought that after he showed his talent, Xiao Ba would become honest, but he didn't expect that the other party would not give up and colluded with the Blood Wolf Gang to kill him.
